body.message:
The deposit for a 1-month stay does add up. To move in April 1st for 1 month, here's what you'd need:

Rent: AED 7,900 (1 month, all-inclusive)
Reservation deposit: first + last month = AED 15,800
Damage deposit: AED 5,000 (refundable)

Total upfront: AED 28,700, of which AED 20,800 comes back to you at the end.

Is there a specific budget in mind? Happy to see what we can work with.
